messages:
Elliot Park: Quick proposal 1: minimal EU spill plan for model-v3. Goals: keep p95 <175ms, cost delta <12%, no VIPs affected unless they opt-in. Plan: micro 0.5% (20m) -> 3% (1h) -> 12% staggered over 8h. Gates on p95, error rate, and eval regression. Thoughts? @samira @owen
Samira Khan: Agree. Add an A/B arm (1% control) to validate regen quality. Flag schema idea: `rollout:model-v3:eu:mode = off|micro|small|ramp|on`, `rollout:model-v3:eu:panic = bool`, `rollout:tenant_holdout:<id> = bool`.
Owen Lee: Telemetry/gating: emit `rollout.p95`, `rollout.err_rate`, `rollout.eval_fail_pct`, `rollout.cost_delta`. Gate policy: 5-min windows, need 2 breaches in 15m to auto-soft-rollback (slice->v2). Hard rollback if storm or eval_fail >5% once.
Samira Khan: Fallback ordering: 1) route to quantized variant in-region (v3-q8), 2) spike -> spill to eu-north, 3) VIPs -> Dedicated pool. Implement `traffic_spill_policy = [quantize, spill-region, dedicated]`.
Elliot Park: Runbook snippet for engineers:
```
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:mode", "micro")
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:panic", false)
feature_flags.set("rollout:tenant_holdout:acct-1234", true)
```
Cost guard: if `rollout.cost_delta` >12% for 2x10m -> throttle to micro and notify finance.
ops-bot: scheduled canary job `canary-v3-eu-compact` -> start 2024-06-15T09:00:00Z. CI: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/7788. Alerts -> #product-rollouts.
Owen Lee: Owners: @Samira telemetry & gating (ETA 48h), @Owen spill automation (ETA 48h), @Elliot runbook + VIP comms (ETA 24h). Proceed if infra delivers by EOD Friday.
Elliot Park: Cool. Keeping this thread as the source for the plan. Flag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
